components under test.
适用场景：工作模式2.1(在休眠模式/关闭模式下确认功能)/3.2/4.2。

shall be performed at Troom, UB for Operating Type 2.1, UA for Operating Type 3.2/4.2, unless
otherwise specified in the Q/JLY J7111029E DUT Test Plan.

equivalent.
所有负载应记录在在Q/JLY J7111029E组件试验计划中。
All loads shall be documented in the Q/JLY J7111029E Component Test Plan.
电源应能够提供足够的电流，以避免在高涌流条件下限流。

high in-rush conditions.

mode)/ 3.2/4.2.

方法：当DUT暴露在在测试环境中测试时，所有DUT输入/输出，显示，人机界面和机械驱

1.9 Monitoring concept and tolerance definition
The NOx signal, O2 and Status Byte will be monitored with a NOx Checkbox via the CAN bus. When
the NOx Checkbox detects a signal out of specification/error condition it generates an error signal which
is monitored with the mask function of an oscilloscope and can be fed back to the test system.
In order to obtain a reliable data transmission outside of the RF chamber and to protect the Checkbox,
unless otherwise stated optical CAN transceivers are used. The NOx Checkbox has an internal CAN
termination of 120Ω, thus care should be taken to provide the other termination resistor for the bus, in
case the DUT does not assemble it, so the result are the standard 60Ω.
In the Oscilloscope (3) different Channels shall be set up:

3. Error Output: signal generated from NOx Checkbox
After switching on the NOx electronics, the sensor heats up. During this phase the Checkbox’s error
output is at low level (0 V). After the heat up phase (up to 5 min) the error o utput stays stable at high
level (5V). At this point the DUT is in FSC A and the test can start.
